title: Cast Your Bread

questions.question: Cast your bread upon the waters, for you will find it after many what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:1 (ESV): "Cast your bread upon the waters, for you will find it after many days."

questions.question: Give a portion to seven, or even to eight, for you know not what disaster may happen on where?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:2 (ESV): "for you know not what disaster may happen on earth."

questions.question: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:3 (ESV): "If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth,"

questions.question: In the morning sow your seed, and at evening withhold not your what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:6 (ESV): "and at evening withhold not your hand,"

questions.question: Rejoice, O young man, in your what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:9 (ESV): "Rejoice, O young man, in your youth,"

questions.question: He who observes the wind will not sow, and he who regards the clouds will not what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:4 (ESV): "and he who regards the clouds will not reap."

questions.question: As you do not know the way the spirit comes to the bones in the womb... so you do not know the work of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:5 (ESV): "so you do not know the work of God who makes everything."

questions.question: Light is sweet, and it is pleasant for the eyes to see the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:7 (ESV): "and it is pleasant for the eyes to see the sun."

questions.question: So if a person lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember that the days of darkness will be what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:8 (ESV): "let him remember that the days of darkness will be many."

questions.question: Remove vexation from your heart, and put away pain from your what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:10 (ESV): "and put away pain from your body,"

questions.question: Walk in the ways of your heart and the sight of your eyes. But know that for all these things God will bring you into what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:9 (ESV): "But know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment."

questions.question: For youth and the dawn of life are what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:10 (ESV): "for youth and the dawn of life are vanity."

questions.question: If a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where the tree falls, there it will do what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:3 (ESV): "in the place where the tree falls, there it will lie."

questions.question: You do not know which will prosper, this or that, or whether both alike will be what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:6 (ESV): "or whether both alike will be good."

questions.question: He who regards the clouds will not reap. This teaches against being overly what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 11:4 (ESV context of observation paralyzing action).

key_verse_text: Cast your bread upon the waters, for you will find it after many days.
